findings.title: Backend API URL exposed in client-side JavaScript
findings.description: The React bundle exposes the backend API base URL: https://project-diabolical.onrender.com/sales. This gives attackers a direct target for the backend infrastructure.
findings.impact: Attackers can bypass the frontend and target the backend directly. Combined with CORS wildcard, this enables cross-origin attacks with stolen tokens.
findings.remediation: Use relative URLs for API calls (e.g., /api/...) or proxy through the same origin. Do not hardcode backend URLs in client-side code.

findings.title: CORS wildcard allows any origin
findings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is present in responses. This allows any website to make cross-origin requests to this API.
findings.impact: If a user visits a malicious site while logged in, that site can steal their Bearer token from localStorage and make authenticated API requests. Combined with MANUAL-001, this is a critical attack path.
findings.remediation: Restrict CORS to specific trusted origins. Do not use wildcard (*) for APIs that accept authenticated requests.

findings.title: Bearer tokens stored in localStorage
findings.description: The application stores access tokens in localStorage and sends them via Authorization: Bearer header.
findings.impact: localStorage is vulnerable to XSS attacks. Any XSS vulnerability would allow token theft. sessionStorage or httpOnly cookies would be more secure.
findings.remediation: Consider using httpOnly, secure cookies for token storage instead of localStorage. This mitigates XSS token theft.

findings.title: Basic authentication implementation present
findings.description: The application implements Basic Auth in addition to Bearer tokens, encoding credentials in base64.
findings.impact: Basic Auth sends credentials with every request. If HTTPS is not enforced everywhere, credentials can be intercepted. Also increases attack surface.
findings.remediation: Remove Basic Auth if not strictly needed. Ensure HTTPS is enforced site-wide (HSTS is already present).
